piping_inventory_write_platform.title: Update OS platform
piping_inventory_write_platform.description: Overwrite the inventory platform from gathered operating-system facts.

piping_inventory_write_device_type.title: Update hardware model
piping_inventory_write_device_type.description: Overwrite manufacturer and device type from gathered hardware facts for physical devices.

piping_inventory_write_serial.title: Update serial / UUID
piping_inventory_write_serial.description: Overwrite device serial or VM product UUID from gathered identity facts.

piping_inventory_write_resources.title: Update CPU and memory
piping_inventory_write_resources.description: Overwrite VM vCPU and memory values from gathered resource facts.

piping_inventory_write_interfaces.title: Update interfaces
piping_inventory_write_interfaces.description: Create and update discovered network interfaces. Disabling this also skips IP and MAC writes.

piping_inventory_write_ip_addresses.title: Update IP addresses
piping_inventory_write_ip_addresses.description: Create and attach discovered IP addresses and set primary IPv4 from gathered facts.

piping_inventory_write_mac_addresses.title: Update MAC addresses
piping_inventory_write_mac_addresses.description: Create and attach discovered MAC addresses to inventory interfaces.

piping_inventory_write_virtual_disks.title: Update VM disks
piping_inventory_write_virtual_disks.description: Create and update virtual disks discovered from block-device facts for VM targets.

piping_inventory_write_ansible_custom_fi.title: Update Ansible metadata
piping_inventory_write_ansible_custom_fi.description: Overwrite the ansible custom-field namespace with kernel, fqdn, BIOS, domain and related raw facts.

piping_inventory_gather_timeout.title: Fact gather timeout
piping_inventory_gather_timeout.description: Per-host Ansible setup timeout in seconds.

piping_inventory_rest_timeout.title: Piping REST timeout
piping_inventory_rest_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the collected-facts ingest request made from the playbook.

piping_inventory_rest_retries.title: Piping REST attempts
piping_inventory_rest_retries.description: Number of attempts for the collected-facts ingest request. Keep this low for large target sets.

piping_inventory_rest_delay.title: Piping REST retry delay
piping_inventory_rest_delay.description: Delay in seconds between REST attempts.
